summaryZh: Liu Research Group 研究低成本、长寿命储能系统和可持续发展相关电化学过程，方向涵盖锂金属电池、固态电解质与安全性，并利用转换反应合成纳米材料及研究电池热力学。
researchQuestions: 如何延长储能系统寿命并降低成本以支持可再生能源电网和电动车？
如何利用电化学过程处理腐蚀、低品位余热和纳米材料生产问题？
topics: 电化学材料与可持续储能
锂金属电池、固态电解质及安全性
腐蚀、余热利用与纳米材料
methods: 转换反应合成纳米材料与热力学分析

evidence.quote: Liu Research Group – Electrochemical Material Science Laboratory
Our research has two inter-related themes: 1.) To develop low-cost, long-life energy storage systems
To study electrochemical processes that underlie a broad range of sustainability issues, including corrosion, low-grade waste heat utilization, and scalable production of functional nanomaterials
We utilize conversion reactions to synthesize nanomaterials and elucidate the thermodynamics of conversion reactions in batteries.
